The main suppliers involved are the firm’s fee protection insurer/broker (making up the majority of the increase through a higher annual premium and additional cover taken out during the year) and the tax investigation support provider whose charges have risen in line with the expanded level of client cover. The variance is primarily due to an uplift in the level of cover offered to clients this year (both in terms of number of clients enrolled and scope of protection), higher underlying premium rates from the insurer compared with the prior year, and timing differences where some costs that were previously falling just outside last year’s reporting period have been captured in the current year, all of which have driven the significant increase from the prior year baseline.
